notes.title: Regarding the Next Update
notes.notes:
[p][b]Based on your feedback, we are actively working on new features and improvements for [i]9th Sentinel Sisters[/i].[/b][/p][p]We’re aiming to deliver the following updates by the end of [b]2025[/b]![/p][p][/p][h3]Planned Features & Improvements[/h3][p][i]Please note: all items are currently under development and may be subject to change.[/i][/p][p]Conversation Enhancements[/p][list][*][p]Add a conversation log feature[/p][/*][*][p]Auto-progress through dialogue scenes[/p][/*][*][p]Improve visibility of item effects during battle[/p][/*][/list][p]Game Experience[/p][list][*][p]UI color change alert when 10 seconds remain[/p][/*][*][p]Instant retry option after Game Over[/p][/*][*][p]Visual cooldown indicators for weapons[/p][/*][*][p]Unlock notification implementation[/p][/*][/list][p]Usability Improvements[/p][list][*][p]Enable mouse cursor navigation in UI/menus[/p][/*][*][p]Map preview after selecting a tile[/p][/*][*][p]Display held parts when opening a supply box[/p][/*][/list][p]Content & System Enhancements[/p][list][*][p]Add a tutorial for the “Customization” system[/p][/*][*][p]Add visual feedback for “Aggressive Advance” in customization[/p][/*][*][p]Allow build details to be reviewed on the result screen[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]This roadmap is based on our current development schedule, and specific release dates may change.
Further updates will be shared in upcoming patch notes.
Thank you for your continued support![/p]

notes.title: 9th Sentinel Sisters — Official Release Announcement
notes.notes:
Thank you for supporting 9th Sentinel Sisters.

We sincerely apologize for the lack of updates since the Early Access launch in October 2023.
We are deeply grateful to everyone who has continued to support us throughout that time.

With today’s update, we’ve significantly expanded the overall game content and added several new features.
Players who purchased the Early Access version can update to the full version free of charge.

We hope you continue to enjoy 9th Sentinel Sisters—the journey is just beginning.

[h1]▼ Additions and Changes Since Early Access[/h1]

[h2]Characters[/h2]
[list]
[*]Three new characters—Nina, Tetra, and Ray—have been added.
[*]A new "Talk" feature is now available on the map, allowing character conversations and events to occur.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44619020/ec3f44ad73f2ef1baea9cb348b6521c02a86c0e1.png[/img]
[*]Your ending will now change depending on which character you used to clear the final missions.
[/list]

[h2]Combat[/h2]
[list]
[*]Certain enemies now drop items upon defeat.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44619020/66eda7c7fb4b8efe9fe3ae35d36e8e5f1949e54e.png[/img]
[*]Epic boss battles against powerful Breed enemies have been added at the end of certain operations.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44619020/4cb83d28321138f84385c0bb605f29be14829708.png[/img]
[/list]

[h2]Operations[/h2]
[list]
[*]Several new operations have been added.
[*]A Shop has been added to the map, allowing you to trade junk for equipment.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44619020/7547f2eb0b0075c02f484cd6e5ffe1a4ce0b3cfe.png[/img]
[*]A new "VR Simulation" feature lets you rematch enhanced bosses after clearing boss missions.
[/list]

[h2]Other Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*]UI improvements
[*]Combat balance adjustments
[*]Graphic enhancements
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes（0.5.0）
notes.notes:
Thank you for your interest in Early Access.
Thank you also for the numerous feedbacks.

Our development team is working hard to prepare for the official release.
We look forward to your continued support of 9th Sentinel Sisters.

[h1][b]Player[/b][/h1]
[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44619020/57af64bdde1a634fe14afff7450966185bc3f70b.png[/img]
[*]Removed the limit on the number of parts you can have and made all parts available.
[*]Various statuses are now displayed in the pause menu during operations.
[*]Changed the appearance rate and calculation method of upgrades that appear when leveling up.
[*]Changed the calculation method of criticality correction and defensive strength.
[*]Changed the method of counting the number of times of resurrection.
[*]Adjusted the method of drawing lots for upgrade choices drawn at level-up.
[/list]

[h1][b]UI[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Changed the font size and color of the damage indicator when a critical hit occurs.
[*]Added images to some items in the manual.
[/list]

[h1][b]Operations[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Adjusted the effect of events that occur in trace reactions.
[*]Weapons and parts can now be obtained before the start of combat in enemy reactions.
[*] Weapons and parts can now be acquired and recovered before the start of a threat enemy reaction.
[*]Blue and red boxes are now guaranteed to appear in supply box reactions.
[*]Increased the probability of the Golden Supply Box appearing in the supply box reaction.
[*]Adjusted the number of encryption keys required to open each supply box.
[*]Adjusted the number of times a supply box can be opened.
[*]Adjusted the HP and knockback values of enemies that come at the player quickly.
[/list]

[h1][b]Weapons, parts, modifications[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Damage of bazookas, iai blades, and plasma cannons have been adjusted.
[*]Maximum levels and effects of parts have been adjusted overall.
[*]Effects of drill level-up have been adjusted.
[*]Overall effects of modifications have been adjusted.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes（Rev 2890）
notes.notes:
Thank you for your interest in Early Access.
This mini-update mainly improves the tempo and difficulty of the early stages of the game, as well as the playing environment.

[h1][b]Player[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]The initial movement speed of the player's ship has been increased.
[*]Reduced  experience required to level up.
[/list]
[h1][b]Battle and enemy[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Reduced the time limit for battles caused by enemy reactions in the early to mid stages of the operation.
[*]Shortened the time limit for Threatening Enemy Reaction battles.
[*]Adjustments have been made to ease the appearance pattern and number of enemy appearances in battles in the early to mid stages of the operation.
[*]The movement speed of enemies moving at high speed has been slowed down.
[/list]
[h1][b]Graphics[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Aim guides indicating the direction of fire are now displayed around your ship.
[*]Adjusted the background of battles caused by Threatening Enemy Reaction.
[*]The UI of the rank-up button in aircraft and weapon modifications has been adjusted.
[/list]
[h1][b]Added optional items[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Added an item for adjusting the dead zone when using the gamepad in the options.
[/list]
[h1][b]Bug fixes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed typos in the Iai blade description text.
[/list]
